description: Post one draft (its text + attached image or video) to one of the social accounts connected to the content space — immediately (publish_at 'now', the default) or at a future ISO time. quote_url (an X post link) posts it as a quote of that post. Steps: (1) call WITHOUT account_id to list the space's accounts (channels: account_id, network, handle, provider, cost_credits); (2) call with account_id and WITHOUT confirmed → a free preview, nothing is posted; show the user exactly what will go out, where and when, and the cost; (3) only after the user says yes, call again with confirmed:true. Cost: 1 credit per post on a Post for Me account (provider postforme), free on the space's own Typefully. This posts PUBLICLY from the user's own account — never post without their explicit yes to that preview. Post now usually returns the live link within ~20s (status live); otherwise status publishing and the link appears on the draft (get_content_draft) a few minutes later. A post the platform rejects goes back to Approved and the credit is refunded. cancel:true cancels a SCHEDULED post (free). No accounts? The user connects one in the content tool (Venues → Scheduling).

account_id.description: From the channels list. Omit to list the space's accounts.

cancel.description: true = cancel this draft's scheduled post.

confirmed.description: true ONLY after the user approved the preview. Omit for a free preview.

draft_id.description: The draft to post. Not needed to list accounts.

publish_at.description: 'now' (default) or a future ISO datetime, e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00:00Z.

quote_url.description: X post URL to quote (makes this a quote post).

name: publish_content_draft
title: Publish a draft now or schedule it
